texts.li: [!lowtech] A cargo pod streaked down and thumped into the ground beyond the colony's fields. The markings say it belongs to {FACTION}, and a message from them is already waiting: it went astray, and they'd like it back, please. The colony could, of course, simply not have seen it.

[lowtech] A pack mule bolted from a caravan of {FACTION}, shed its load on the colony's land and vanished over the hills. A rider from {FACTION} is already asking after the goods. The colony can send them back, or keep them and say nothing.

li.label: Send it back
li.outcome: The cargo goes back to {FACTION}, with the colony's compliments. They won't forget it.

li.label: Keep it
li.outcome: The colony keeps the cargo. {FACTION} have their suspicions, and they're right.

li.label: Send it back, and ask for a finder's fee
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} sent the cargo back with a polite note about the colony's trouble, and {FACTION} paid {COUNT} silver as a finder's fee.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {B_nameDef} loaded the goods on a cart and walked them back to {FACTION}'s rider, mentioning the long walk more than once. They paid {COUNT} silver for the trouble.
[b:past:trader] {B_nameDef} has been on the other side of this kind of deal, and knew what to ask. {FACTION} got their cargo back and paid {COUNT} silver for the favor.

li.riskOutcome: {B_nameDef} asked {FACTION} for a finder's fee, and they took it badly. The cargo went back with no fee, and they think less of the colony for asking.

texts.li: [!lowtech] A recruiter from {FACTION}, with polished boots and a polished smile, has heard about {A_nameDef}'s {SKILL}. {FACTION} would pay the colony {COUNT} silver to take over {A_possessive} contract, and pay {A_objective} a fine wage besides. The recruiter is very sure {A_nameDef} will say yes.

[lowtech,!tribal] A steward of {FACTION} has come with an offer. The steward's lord has heard of {A_nameDef}'s {SKILL}, and would pay the colony {COUNT} silver to take {A_objective} into service. It's a good post in a great house, the steward says, with room and board.
[tribal] Elders of {FACTION} have sent word. They've heard of {A_nameDef}'s {SKILL}, and would give the colony {COUNT} silver if {A_nameDef} came to live among them and teach their young.

li.label: Accept ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} packs up and goes with them. The silver is counted out on the table, and it sits there a long while before anyone puts it away.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} decide
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} thinks it over and decides to stay. "This is home," is all {A_nameDef} will say about it.
li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} thinks it over and takes the offer. There are handshakes and a few tears, and then {A_nameDef} is gone down the road.

li.label: Not for sale
li.outcome: The offer is turned down flat. {A_nameDef} heard every word of it, and is in a fine mood all day.

texts.li: [!lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a journalist of {FACTION} with a notebook and a camera, wants to write about the colony: how it lives, what it stands for and what it's known for. The piece will be widely read, and {X_nameDef} would like the tour.

[lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a chronicler of {FACTION}, travels the land recording the deeds of its settlements, and would like to record the colony's. What {X_nameDef} writes will be copied and read far from here, if the colony agrees to show {X_objective} around.

li.label: Give {X_objective} the tour
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} writes it all down. Word will get around.

li.label: Turn the writer away
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} shrugs and writes a short piece anyway, about a colony that keeps its doors shut.

li.label: Give the tour, with {A_nameDef} doing the talking
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} showed {X_nameDef} the best of the colony and steered the questions away from the rest. The piece, when it comes out, will be kind.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {A_nameDef} walked the chronicler through the fields and the hall, and told the colony's story the way it ought to be told. The chronicle will be kind.

li.riskOutcome: {A_nameDef} talked too much and too freely, and {X_nameDef} wrote down every word. The piece is not kind.

texts.li: [!lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a traveling doctor of {FACTION}, is going from settlement to settlement with a case of vaccines. For {COUNT} silver, everyone in the colony gets a shot, and for a month they'll fight off sickness noticeably better.

[lowtech] {X_nameDef}, a wandering herbalist of {FACTION}, sells a bitter tonic said to keep the coughing sickness away. For {COUNT} silver there's enough for every colonist, and for a month they would shake off sickness faster. The herbalist's last customers swear by it.

li.label: Pay {COUNT} silver
li.outcome: Each colonist gets a dose, and most of them complain about it.

li.label: No, thank you
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} packs up the case and moves on to the next settlement.

li.label: Pay half, and have {X_objective} teach {A_nameDef}
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} spent the afternoon showing {A_nameDef} how the medicine is made and how much to give. There were no doses this time, but {A_nameDef} filled a notebook.

outcomes.li: [lowtech] {X_nameDef} took {A_nameDef} out to the fields and the treeline and showed {A_objective} which roots go into the tonic. {A_nameDef} came back with a full basket and a head full of names.

texts.li: [!lowtech] The comms console, left scanning overnight, picked up a far-off station that plays very old records, with one host and no ads. Colonists keep finding reasons to work within earshot.
[lowtech] Minstrels have made camp on the hill beyond the fields, and in the evenings their music drifts down over the colony. People linger outside after supper to listen.

[!lowtech] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, whose face is on posters all over the region, is stopping at the colony for the night, wearing sunglasses and hoping for a quiet evening. The colonists recognized {X_objective} the moment {X_pronoun} walked in.

[lowtech,!tribal] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, a tourney champion whose name turns up in songs from here to the sea, is stopping the night. {A_nameDef} has already asked about the scar across {X_possessive} cheek.
[tribal] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, a hunter so famous that children play at being {X_objective}, is resting at the colony for a night, and the colony's hunters have a lot of questions.

lines.li: No, I won't do the voice.
...and then I said, "not in this hat."
